capacityToAct.description: Coordinate color, pedal, and audio responses while ignoring visual distractions.

gridClassification.description: Discover a rule in two example grids, then choose the two candidates that follow it.

deductiveReasoning.description: Find the missing shape in 4×4 and 5×5 grids using row and column rules.

oddOneOut.description: Infer the rule shared by nine objects and identify the one that breaks it.

reactionTime.description: Measure how quickly you respond to a visual cue across a configurable series of trials.

towerOfHanoi.description: Plan and execute a legal disk sequence while tracking moves and working speed.

dividedAttention.description: Steer through configurable traffic while responding to left and right signal changes.

switchReasoning.description: Trace shape sequences through one or two numerical codes to find the matching output.

monotony.description: Classify a long sequence of similar symbols while tracking speed and mistakes.

digitChallenge.description: Fill arithmetic equations with distinct digits from 1 to 9 to reach the given result.

distributiveAttention.description: Coordinate rows and columns using intersection selection or simultaneous two-hand responses.

numericalReasoning.description: Explore four sample businesses through detailed tables and interactive charts. Evaluate statements as True, False, or Cannot say, and revisit your answers.

greenGreyClassification.description: Infer the rule separating six labeled diamond grids, then classify four new grids as green or gray.

concentration.description: Quickly classify E-like symbols by their shape and dot count, using A/D keys or touch controls.

motionPlanning.description: Rearrange movable blocks around fixed obstacles and guide the red ball to its target in as few moves as possible.

workingMemory.description: Remember highlighted dots in order while solving symmetry, rotation, and line-figure questions.

shortTermMemory.description: Remember which cells flashed in a configurable grid and round count.

perception.description: Use independently chosen left and right layouts for one coordinated two-hand response.

home.description: A collection of focused exercises for practicing common cognitive tasks. Your results stay in this browser and remain available for later review.
home.title: Focus, react, remember, adapt.
home.disclaimer: These exercises are for practice and self-observation, not clinical assessment.
